description: ZCode hook wiring (experimental adapter, not a 0.4.3 release target). Only events and tool names verified against the fetched ZCode hook schema (zcode.z.ai/en/docs/hooks, 2026-09-19) and tools observed in a live session are wired: process executors via argv (no shell), ${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT} paths, Bash and Write|Edit matchers, SessionStart startup|resume|clear|compact. The Claude-transcript and Codex-rollout Stop readers and the flow-order guard stay unwired (see docs/runtime-adapter.md). Each handler passes --zcode-runtime as a literal second argv element: together with ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT, which plugin hook processes receive as an environment variable (live hook doc, 2026-10-08), it flips the shared scripts to ZCode output mode (hooks/hook-output.mjs) so stdout carries only documented keys - a decision as hookSpecificOutput alone, a warn as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. The advisory top-level systemMessage channel is a Claude Code convention the live doc reports as ignored and the bundled diagnosing-hooks skill reports as a failed run with the effect discarded (strict schema, pitfall 8); a marketplace install runs these scripts on machines this repo does not control, so the wire depends on no machine-specific path and emits no undeclared channel.
